newsitem.title: USA: Gum Tech to redeem stock purchase warrants.
newsitem.headline: Gum Tech to redeem stock purchase warrants.

text.p: Gum Tech International Inc said Friday that it elected to call for redemption its 460,000 common-stock purchase warrants outstanding as of July 20.
Each warrant, redeemable at $0.01, is exercisable for purchase of one share of the company's common stock at $7.50 per share, the company said.
The warrants were issued at the company's April 24, 1996, initial public offering, Gum Tech said in a news release.
Proceeds from the redemption will be for a second manufacturing and warehouse facility to meet the needs of increased demand resulting from several new contracts, Gum Tech said.
